description: uWebSockets.js, the Node binding of the uWebSockets C++ server, one cluster worker per core. Raw uWS App API throughout - no router, middleware or body parser. JSON.stringify per request, gzip through the Node zlib bindings, static files read from disk on every request, TLS on :8081 through uWS's own SSLApp. Database profiles use the pg driver with libpq bindings and a pool sized from DATABASE_MAX_CONN; crud reads go through the harness's Redis sidecar, which the profile allows for one-process-per-core runtimes.
